visual.general_description: Three-panel color photograph series (A, B, C) of the nipple-areola region: a small skin nodule with a ruler, an open surgical defect with an orange flap design, and a torso with a dressing and nipples after repair.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph of hair-covered skin of the upper chest. A small pink-red raised nodule with a smooth surface is visible, and a small flat dark purple-brown spot lies next to it. A white plastic ruler with printed graduations is held against the skin by a finger at the lower edge. A blue-green fabric drape is visible along one edge of the frame. The letter A is printed at the lower left corner. The ruler numerals are too small to read. Close-up color photograph of an open skin wound with red irregular edges. The wound base shows yellow lobulated tissue and darker tissue at the upper part of the defect. An orange line drawing of a chevron-like outline with a curved notch is superimposed beside the wound. Blue handwritten ink marks are visible near one edge of the frame and are not legible. The letter B is printed at the lower left corner. Color photograph of the front of a hairy torso with the head cropped out of the frame. A rectangular white adhesive dressing lies across the lower chest. One nipple shows a small reddish spot and the nipple on the other side of the chest has a thin linear scar line beside it with a small raised crusted area. A skin crease crosses the abdomen below the dressing and a blue-green drape is visible along the edges. The letter C is printed at the lower left corner. No face is visible.
